run.command: strata bench run --url http://127.0.0.1:8080 --suite standard-v1 --optional-concurrency --track custom --track-notes Strata 0.2.1 (upstream 9ae93f7b) + 10 commits (github.com/shenmintao/Strata branch nas/gfx1200-021 @ 690e4f6f: Q4_0-KV WMMA prompt attention STRATA_HIP_WMMA_Q4, conversation disk tier, elastic CPU image encoder, /v1/models fields, retuned gfx1200 hipBLASLt table, NAS Docker build); Docker on fnOS (Debian 12), ROCm 7.2.3 userspace; run config: IQ2_XS native pack, --kv q4_0 --max-context 524288 --batch 2 --batch-mtp --prefill 8192 --spec 4 --spec-min-p 0.5 --resident-experts --pool-workers 13 --vram-reserve-mib 896 --vision (CPU encoder, elastic); env GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 HSA_ENABLE_SDMA=1 STRATA_ATTN_LANECELL=1 STRATA_DMA_BATCH=0 STRATA_HC_Q8=1 STRATA_HIPBLASLT_TUNING=<the retuned 162-row gfx1200 table> STRATA_HIP_QUEUE_PRIME=0 STRATA_HIP_WMMA_Q4=1 STRATA_MTP_SIDE_STREAM=1 STRATA_PF_FUSED=1 STRATA_POOL_SPIN_US=0 STRATA_PREFILL_RING=384 STRATA_RESIDENT_HEADROOM_GIB=5 STRATA_ROUTE_TAIL_SKIP=7 STRATA_SELECT_WMMA=1 --model-revision ed59f92082b1e93c0e96d60a8b11aab089b52f09 --quantization IQ2_XS --custom-pack tools/iq_pack.py native pack of the ISTA-DASLab GSQ-RCO IQ2_XS GGUF (experts read in place); shipped expert profile; MTP draft layer data/mtp/rt --background household voice assistant (open-xiaoai) on the same engine: prompt-prefix warm-ups about every 20 min --background Qwen3-ASR on the Intel iGPU, March7 TTS on CPU (idle unless spoken to) --build-options HIP_ARCH=gfx1200,STRATA_PREFILL_MMQ=ON,Release --out /state/bench021p/run
